# Slite

Your company knowledge base, on autopilot

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/slite/.

## Actions

- **Ask Question** (read-only): Ask a question to your Slite notes in natural language.
- **Create Note**: Create a note from markdown or HTML content with optional template.
- **Delete Note By ID**: Permanently delete a note and all its children by ID.
- **Get authenticated user** (read-only): Retrieves information about the currently authenticated user.
- **Get Note By ID** (read-only): Retrieve a complete note by its ID including content in Markdown or HTML format.
- **Get Note Children** (read-only): Retrieve note children by parent note ID.
- **List Notes** (read-only): List notes from Slite with optional filtering by owner.
- **Search Groups** (read-only): Search for groups by name in Slite.
- **Search Notes** (read-only): Search notes based on a query with optional filters.
- **Search Users** (read-only): Search for users in Slite by email, name, or username.
- **Update Note**: Update a note's content with markdown and/or title.
- **Update Note Archived State**: Update the archived state of a note in Slite.
- **Update Note Owner**: Update the owner of a note.
- **Verify Note**: Set a note's verification status to Verified with optional expiration.
- **Flag Note as Outdated**: Set Outdated status on a note with a reason.
- **Update Tile in Note**: Update or create a tile within a Slite note with structured header and markdown content.
